transcript: Speaker A (Woman): Hello, where are you? I have been waiting. Speaker B (Driver): Haan... I am... I am... wo aap side nahi straight aao. Speaker A: What? I can't understand. Can you tell me in English where you are? Speaker B: Madam coffee... wo... wo bade shop ke paas white car. Speaker A: Sorry, I am getting late. I'm cancelling. [6 months later] Speaker B: Hello ma'am, I am near the coffee shop by the signal, white car number 42. I am putting my lights on, you can see? Speaker A: Oh, perfect! I see you. I am coming there. Speaker B: 6 mahine pehle meri woh halat thi aur aaj main yeh hoon. Rasta sab pata the, gaadi paas hi khadi hoti thi par customer English mein poochta, 'kahan ho?' aur main do shabd theek se bol nahi pata, toh ride cancel kar deta. Bahut saari rides isi wajah se gayi. Mujhe laga tha English mere jaise logon ke liye hai hi nahi. Par ek customer ne bola, 'English Seekho' app try karo. Isne meri poori soch hi badal di. Speaker C (Presenter): Usme sab kuch step-by-step hai bilkul shuru se. Roz ki kaam ki English, normal daily conversation kaise karein, sab Hindi mein samjhaya hua hai chhote-chhote videos mein. Aur isme ek AI coach hai, Disha, jisse chat ya voice note bhejkar practice kar sakte hain. Speaker B: Gaadi mein baith kar, customer ke wait mein, red light pe, bas thoda-thoda roz practice kiya. Aaj cancel hona band ho gaya, rating sabse upar hai, aur pehle se double kama raha hoon. English na aana koi sharm ki baat nahi, par use na seekhna apne aap ko rok lena hai. Ek baar English Seekho try karke dekho aur life aasaan banao. Speaker D (Voiceover): Install now par click karo aur abhi English Seekho app download karo.
